scope: Read-only classification of original saved commands/results; no execution or repair.

timeout_executions.command: source $HOME/.cargo/env && cd /workspace && cmake --build build --target mmseqs -j2 2>&1 | tail -20

explicit_background_build.command:
source $HOME/.cargo/env && cd /workspace/build && make -j2 2>&1 | tail -30 &
echo "Build started in background, PID=$!"

facts: Initial full build requested -j$(nproc); a later build used -j2.
Upstream then explicitly launched background make -j2 and continued checking files.
No SAVE_SETUP, completed image, PR discovery or runtime test parsing was reached.
limits: Actual compiler parallelism, process saturation, OOM state and whether earlier timed-out commands remained alive were not measured. The later background build was explicitly requested by upstream, so its presence alone is not proof of a leaked process. CPU/time choices can affect build progress; no alternate resource/timeout configuration was tested.
